title: Repository Large-File Decomposition for Localization, Settings, Storage and Cameras
summary: Decomposes the largest localization, Settings, Storage integrity and camera ONVIF modules into focused owners while preserving existing routes, UI behavior, permissions and update, backup and restore contracts.
changelog: Splits localization dictionaries into dedicated English, Russian, Chinese and shared legacy modules while preserving locale lookup behavior.
Extracts update-apply and shared Settings presentation helpers behind the existing public facades.
Extracts Storage archive-integrity presentation and action helpers behind the existing public facade.
Moves camera connection and onboarding helpers plus ONVIF route families into dedicated backend modules without API contract changes.
Separates the Settings Maintenance controller and state from its presentation surface while preserving existing maintenance behavior.

ru: Словари локализации разделены на английский, русский, китайский и общий legacy-модуль без изменения поиска переводов.
Логика применения обновлений и общие presentation helpers настроек вынесены за существующие публичные фасады.

将摄像机连接、引导逻辑和 ONVIF 路由族移入独立后端模块，不改变 API 契约。
将设置维护页的控制器和状态与展示界面分离，同时保持现有维护行为。
